recipes.name: Simply Potatoes® Easy Shepherd's Pie
ingredients_raw: 1 (24 ounce) package Simply Potatoes® Mashed Potatoes

steps.text: Heat oven to 375 degrees F. Spray 2-1/2 to 3 quart casserole baking dish with nonstick cooking spray.*

In 12-inch skillet cook ground beef and onion until browned; drain grease. Add beans, corn, tomatoes, gravy, thyme and salt. Cook until heated through. Spoon beef mixture into casserole dish. Spread Simply Potatoes® evenly over beef mixture. Bake 30 to 35 minutes or until edges are bubbly. Remove from oven.
Heat broiler. Broil casserole 4 to 6 inches from heat, 3 to 5 minutes, until Simply Potatoes® are lightly browned.

raw_recipe.headline: Simply Potatoes® Easy Shepherd's Pie

review.reviewBody: This was a BIG hit!!! Even better the next day. I did make a few changes. I used a jar of mushroom gravy in place of the beef and added some sliced mushrooms at the same time as the veggies. Also I used 3 pouches of Betty Crocker instant Garlic Mashed Potatoes. My hubby really liked it and said "I could definately eat this again"

Shepherd's Pie uses lamb, Cottage Pie uses beef, I used ground turkey and turkey gravy so I called it Gobbler Pie and it was delicious! I used a bag of mixed veggies, 3 cups (defrosted and drained overnight), and decreased the thyme to 1/2 tsp. since I didn't know how it would taste with ground turkey. I used Philadelphia Chive and Onion mashed potatoes which I microwaved for approximately 1 1/2 minutes to make it easier to spread. The only downfall was I didn't have a long 2 quart baking dish so it was runny--it didn't look like the picture someone else posted. I will definitely make it again but I will buy a long 2 qt baking dish my round dish did not work well.

I’ve made it only I used russet potatoes mashed with sour cream and spread a layer of it before putting the meat mixture. Then I spread the rest on the top with grated cheese. My husband can’t get enough of it, I have to make it for him and his brothers once a week

The ground meat was made with my Hispanic touch (picadillo) Did not have corn, i used a can green beans. I made the potatoes from the bag with garlic & pepper. I put mozzarella shredded cheese in between the meat & the potatoes. Yum

SO Easy and really turned out tasty. Kids really loved it which is a bonus.
I used Heinz jarred beef gravy which I wasn't too sure about but tasted good. I used garlic salt instead of thyme and I used garlic mashed potatoes. 

We will make this again.

I used canned vegetables instead of frozen and added peas and carrots. I also added a small amount of cheese on top for a little extra flavor. I thought 1 tsp. of thyme was a bit too strong. Next time I'll only use 1/2 tsp. of thyme. Otherwise it was a great meal and my family and guests loved it. It made plenty for 5 (with leftovers)and I had enough to freeze for another meal.

I needed a new shepherd's pie recipe and this one definitely fit the bill. No one in my family likes onions so I omitted them, and I substituted green peas instead of the beans because I already had them on hand. I think next time I'm going to add some fresh mushrooms to the mix. My 7 year old son loved this recipe and asked if it could be added to the menu again soon.

Simply amazing. I had some frozen ground beef and wanted to make a yummy dinner and stumbled on this recipe and so happy I did. So easy to make, will definitely make again! I used instant cheddar garlic mashed potatoes (because thats all I had) I also added some fresh celery. Really enjoyed this dinner.

i was looking for a sheperds pie recipe and this one seemed to be the best. i cooked it for 10 people at work and it was a big hit. i added a few dashes of worchestersihre sauce and a small can of tomato paste. i like ground beef and gravy mixes to be a little tomatoy, not like spaghetti sauce, but with that tomato flavor. i also melted some cheese on top. i didnt broil it like it says for the last few minutes. my only problem was i ran out of potatos, buy an extra container. A++ recipe.

This was fantastic!! Everyone told me "this is a do again" (how we rate new recipes). I did make a couple changes based on what other posters suggested: 1/2 the thyme, cheese on top of the potatoes (prior to broiler), cream of celery soup, and a little extra salt and pepper. Also, the store I shop at does not carry the Simply Potatoes mashed potatoes so I substituted them for another brand of refrigerated potatoes. Very easy and cheap to make!

Yesterday I thought Shepherd's Pie was actually a pie. A coworker suggested I try it, and this recipe was great! I used canned vegetables and omitted the gravy because it just didn't sound good to me. I used a store brand butter & herb instant mashed potatoes, and added some garlic salt and pepper. I didn't broil it, and next time I plan on adding cheddar cheese to the top. My fiance and I loved it!
Another recipe that’s been used in my family for years now! It’s always a hit when I make it for friends/family. One of my husbands faves.
I added one cup of porter beer and the gravy was made with a powdered gravy. The Porter and some milk were added to the gravy.

I always make a new recipe exactly as called for the first time through, so I made no changes or substitutions to this and it was pretty much a dud in my household. It was too soupy (yes I drained the grease and tomatoes) and the package of potatoes called for was nowhere near enough to adequately cover the top. Might try again with more potatoes and no tomatoes (my picky teen didn't appreciate them), or try a different recipe.

It was too much tomato for my liking. This is a fairly simple recipe so I !ay make it again. If I do I'll cut the tomato in half. Also, one review mentioned adding mushrooms. That would add a more hearty flavor.

It was super easy to make. My grandmother has been loosing weight so I thought this would be a great all in one meal to help. I did not add the tomatoes thou, used packaged brown gravy and Betty Crocker loaded mashed potatoes instead. I will be adding a few things next time I make it thou. Like garlic, mushrooms and bell pepper.

I thought this recipe was okay. My kids and my husband really like it though. I used extra lean ground beef to cut down on the fat but I think it also maybe made it less flavorful. It was definitely easy to throw together.
Fast and easy. My family loved it. Didn't change anything except used a 9x12 baking dish with a little more potatoes. Thanks!!
Very good, easy to make.
Love this recipe!
